description: This file implements the SystemTrustStore interface for different platforms, providing platform-specific trust store management and initialization logic, including dummy implementations and support for NSS, Mac, Fuchsia, Windows, Android, and Starboard.

classes.name: DummySystemTrustStore
classes.description: A dummy implementation of SystemTrustStore that does not use the system trust store.

classes.name: SystemTrustStoreChromeWithUnOwnedSystemStore
classes.description: A SystemTrustStore implementation that combines Chrome's trust store with an external system trust store without taking ownership.

classes.name: SystemTrustStoreChrome
classes.description: A SystemTrustStore that includes Chrome's trust store and an external system trust store.

classes.name: SystemTrustStoreNSS
classes.description: A platform-specific trust store implementation for NSS (used on Linux/ChromeOS).

classes.name: SystemTrustStoreFuchsia
classes.description: A trust store implementation for Fuchsia platform, loading root certs from a file.

classes.name: SystemTrustStoreWin
classes.description: A trust store implementation for Windows platform.

classes.name: SystemTrustStoreAndroid
classes.description: A trust store implementation for Android platform.

classes.name: StarboardSystemCerts
classes.description: A class managing trust store for Starboard platform, using in-memory trust store.

classes.name: SystemTrustStoreStarboard
classes.description: A trust store implementation for Starboard platform, using Cobalt's trust store.

methods.name: UsesSystemTrustStore
methods.description: Indicates whether the trust store uses the system trust store.

methods.name: IsKnownRoot
methods.description: Checks if a given certificate is a known root.

methods.name: CreateSslSystemTrustStore
methods.description: Factory function to create the platform-specific trust store.

methods.name: CreateSslSystemTrustStoreChromeRoot
methods.description: Factory function to create trust store with Chrome root support.

methods.name: InitializeTrustCacheForCRSOnWorkerThread
methods.description: Initializes trust cache on a worker thread for Chrome Root Store support.

methods.name: InitializeTrustStoreMacCache
methods.description: Initializes the Mac trust cache asynchronously.

methods.name: CreateSslSystemTrustStoreNSSWithUserSlotRestriction
methods.description: Creates NSS trust store with a specific user slot restriction.

methods.name: CreateSslSystemTrustStoreChromeRootWithUserSlotRestriction
methods.description: Creates Chrome trust store with user slot restriction.

methods.name: CreateSslSystemTrustStore
methods.description: Creates a dummy trust store for unsupported platforms.
